deviations: ri::genprobexact / ri::estate are not installed; assignment probabilities computed as the within-city share of treated barangays (exact for this complete block-cluster randomization), and the ITT computed as the IPW-weighted OLS of the outcome on assignment plus city dummies, which is what ri::estate does when given X and prob. Randomization-inference p-values were not computed (not claimed).

survey_ind.RData and survey_agg.RData are not shipped; they were rebuilt from survey_raw.RData following survey_clean.R (control-group-standardized items, inverse-covariance weighted indices). The fastLink name match of survey to official barangays was replaced by an exact barangay-name merge on the 10 treated surveyed barangays (all 10 linked; only treated barangays enter the attendance weights).
Clustered SEs by barangay computed with sandwich::vcovCL (HC1) rather than the authors' varcov.cluster; only point estimates are scored.
notes: Followed tables_figures_agg.R (Table 1), survey_clean.R + tables_fig_ind.R (Tables C.3, C.4: attendance-weighted city-FE regressions on assignment by party) and tables_fig_ind_unweighted.R (Table F.1: assignment-IPW-weighted city-FE regressions). attempt-1 was an exploratory data inspection with no RESULT lines.
